title: A withheld or retired delivery closes the grant without sending its pending inter-turn observation
outcome: When a granted turn's delivery is withheld at its opening, the inter_turn_change for the drift it measured is not recorded before the grant closes. The withholding causes are: an earlier observation still unaccounted, a missing canonical proof, a repeated policy refusal, an 8-attempt retirement, or an unaccounted non-root-move receipt (engram_source_observation_runtime.rs:76-78, :122, :310, :320-325, :533, :553-556). Automatic retirement closes the grant with an empty checkpoint without sending it (engram_source_observation_recovery.rs:54-94); it goes out only on an explicit Resume (:151-209). The drift then reaches the store late or never, after a checkpoint. Either the drift reaches the store before or with the retirement, or a durable visible hold says it was not reported.
acceptance: Tests drive each withholding cause to automatic retirement and show either that the measured inter_turn_change is recorded before the retiring checkpoint, or that a durable, visible host diagnostic names the unreported drift and its cause; no path retires silently.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
